subject: MAP sprint: owners, deliverables, and proposed 6-week close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP sprint: owners, deliverables, and proposed 6-week close timeline

Hi Taylor — great to meet you on the call earlier. Per our conversation I wanted to get an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) skeleton in motion so we have clear owners and a realistic timeline to evaluate Redwood across the three core milestones we discussed (pilot data ingest, latency/cost verification, and integration QA).

High-level proposed 6-week sprint (shorthand):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, stakeholders & access (data, VPN/whitelists), sign EULA/LOU if needed
- Weeks 1–2: Pilot ingest & baseline perf (Marissa owns infra/ingest tasks)
- Weeks 3–4: Integration QA, latency tuning, quantization profile tests (Neha + Marissa)
- Week 5: Exec review & decision readout; procurement/contract negotiation parallel path

Proposed owners (please confirm or update):
- Customer Champion / Project Lead: Taylor Morgan (Novacare)
- Technical Lead: Alyssa Chen (Novacare) — will own data mapping and integration validation
- Procurement / Legal contact: Ravi Srinivasan (Novacare)
- Redwood SE / Pilot PM: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)
- Redwood AE: Jordan Blake (me)

Attachments: I attached a one-page MAP draft and an eval playbook with suggested tests. I also linked a Drive folder where we can drop logs, test prompts, and the onboarding checklist.

Asks from us to get started:
1) Confirm owners above and add any other stakeholders we should loop in (security, compliance, exec sponsor).
2) Confirm data access window (can we get a 48–72 hour test dataset by EOD Monday?).
3) Share any procurement timing constraints (target PO date or internal review cycles).

I'll put a 30-minute kickoff on the calendar for Monday morning with the MAP doc live so we can assign granular tasks. If Monday doesn't work, propose an alternate time and we'll adjust.

Thanks — excited to get moving.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Novacare_MAP_draft_20260522.xlsx (spreadsheet), Novacare_Eval_Playbook_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@novacare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novacare.com>, Ravi Srinivasan <ravi.s@novacare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP sprint: owners, deliverables, and proposed 6-week close timeline

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the docs. Alyssa and I reviewed and the proposed plan looks good overall. A few notes: 

- Confirmed owners: I will act as project champion and coordinate exec check-ins. Alyssa will be the technical lead. Ravi is procurement and will need early visibility into any commercial or data residency items.
- Data: We can package a 48-hour anonymized extract by Tuesday EOD (we're finalizing a scrub step).
- Timeline: We are generally aligned on 6 weeks but would like to compress the perf verification into week 1 (so we can parallelize integration in weeks 2–3) — will that be feasible on your side?
- Security: Our InfoSec will want the SOC2 evidence and an initial network diagram ahead of pilot ingest. Can Marissa drop that into the Drive folder?

I'll accept the Monday kickoff if you send a calendar option. Also looping Ravi so procurement visibility starts now.

Thanks,
Taylor Morgan
Senior Product Manager, Data Integrations
Novacare Health

On Fri, May 22, 2026 at 09:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Taylor — great to meet you on the call earlier. Per our conversation I wanted to get an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) skeleton in motion...

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP sprint: owners, deliverables, and proposed 6-week close timeline

Thanks Taylor — I uploaded the security pack and our standard network diagram to the shared Drive folder (link in the MAP doc). I also added a short checklist under the "Pilot ingest" tab with the exact file layout and SFTP creds format we expect.

On the timeline question: we can compress the perf verification into week 1 if Novacare's test dataset is ready by Tuesday EOD and we have a dedicated infra window. I'll coordinate with our infra team to reserve a slot; I'll also seed the eval playbook with a small set of latency/cost hypotheses so we can validate quickly.

Calendar: Jordan — I created a tentative 30-minute kickoff for Monday 10:00 AM PT (invite pending from you).

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer / Pilot PM | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_security_pack_v3.pdf (security pack), pilot_ingest_checklist.csv (spreadsheet)

From: Ravi Srinivasan <ravi.s@novacare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP sprint: owners, deliverables, and proposed 6-week close timeline

Jordan/Taylor — looping in briefly from procurement. A couple quick asks so we understand the contracting runway:
1) Can you confirm the standard SOW template and whether any unusual clauses (data residency, indemnity caps) are required for the pilot?
2) If things proceed on the 6-week window, what is the earliest PO date we should plan for internal approvals? We typically need three weeks for a standard vendor PO after final SOW.

If you can share a redline-friendly SOW and a short note on the pilot commercial model (credits vs. short-term license) I can route that internally. Thanks — Ravi

—
Ravi Srinivasan
Sr. Procurement Manager | Novacare Health
ravi.s@novacare.com
